```diff
+                     </div>
+                     <div class="input-group">
+                         <label>Rate ($/hr)</label>
+                         <input type="number" id="manualRate" min="0" max="100" step="0.5" value="24" required>
+                     </div>
+                 </div>
+                 <div class="form-row">
+                     <div class="input-group">
+                         <label>Start Time</label>
+                         <input type="time" id="manualStartTime" required>
+                     </div>
+                     <div class="input-group">
+                         <label>End Time</label>
+                         <input type="time" id="manualEndTime" required>
+                     </div>
+                 </div>
+                 <div class="form-row full">
+                     <div class="input-group">
+                         <label>Note (optional)</label>
+                         <input type="text" id="manualNote" placeholder="What did you work on?">
+                     </div>
+                 </div>
+                 <div class="modal-actions">
+                     <button type="submit" class="btn-modal-primary">Add Session</button>
+                     <button type="button" class="btn-modal-secondary" onclick="closeAddSessionModal()">Cancel</button>
+                 </div>
+             </form>
+         </div>
+     </div>
+ 
+     <!-- Add Bill Modal -->
+     <div class="modal" id="addBillModal">
+         <div class="modal-content">
+             <div class="modal-header">💸 Add Bill</div>
+             <form onsubmit="addBill(event)">
+                 <div class="form-row full">
+                     <div class="input-group">
+                         <label>Bill Name</label>
+                         <input type="text" id="billName" placeholder="e.g., Rent, Utilities" required>
+                     </div>
+                 </div>
+                 <div class="form-row">
+                     <div class="input-group">
+                         <label>Amount CAD</label>
+                         <input type="number" id="billAmountCAD" step="0.01" min="0" placeholder="0.00" required onchange="autoCalculateUSD()">
+                     </div>
+                     <div class="input-group">
+                         <label>Amount USD</label>
+                         <input type="number" id="billAmountUSD" step="0.01" min="0" placeholder="0.00" required>
+                     </div>
+                 </div>
+                 <div class="form-row full">
+                     <div class="input-group">
+                         <label>Due Date (optional)</label>
+                         <input type="date" id="billDueDate">
+                     </div>
+                 </div>
+                 <div class="modal-actions">
+                     <button type="submit" class="btn-modal-primary">Add Bill</button>
+                     <button type="button" class="btn-modal-secondary" onclick="closeAddBillModal()">Cancel</button>
+                 </div>
+             </form>
+         </div>
+     </div>
+ 
+     <script src="js/api.js"></script>
+     <script>
+         // Global State
+         const DEADLINE = new Date('2025-10-24T23:59:59');
+         let TOTAL_NEEDED = 2945;
+         let currentUser = null;
+         let timerInterval = null;
+         let timerSeconds = 0;
+         let isTimerRunning = false;
+         let sessions = [];
+         let bills = [];
+ 
+         // Auth Check & Initialization
+         window.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', async () => {
+             const token = localStorage.getItem('authToken');
+             if (!token) {
+                 window.location.href = '/login.html';
+                 return;
+             }
+ 
+             try {
+                 currentUser = await window.api.getProfile();
+                 await loadDashboardData();
+                 initializeTimers();
+             } catch (error) {
+                 console.error('Auth error:', error);
+                 window.location.href = '/login.html';
+             }
+         });
+ 
+         function initializeTimers() {
+             setInterval(updateCountdown, 1000);
+             updateCountdown();
+             
+             const today = new Date();
+             const manualDateEl = document.getElementById('manualDate');
+             const viewDateEl = document.getElementById('viewDate');
+             if (manualDateEl) manualDateEl.valueAsDate = today;
+             if (viewDateEl) viewDateEl.valueAsDate = today;
+         }
+ 
+         // Load All Dashboard Data
+         async function loadDashboardData() {
+             await Promise.all([
+                 loadSessions(),
+                 loadBills(),
+                 loadStats()
+             ]);
+         }
+ 
+         // Countdown Timer
+         function updateCountdown() {
+             const now = new Date();
+             const diff = DEADLINE - now;
+             const countdownEl = document.getElementById('countdown');
+             
+             if (!countdownEl) return;
+             
+             if (diff <= 0) {
+                 countdownEl.textContent = 'DEADLINE PASSED';
+                 return;
+             }
+             
+             const days = Math.floor(diff / (1000 * 60 * 60 * 24));
+             const hours = Math.floor((diff % (1000 * 60 * 60 * 24)) / (1000 * 60 * 60));
+             const minutes = Math.floor((diff % (1000 * 60 * 60)) / (1000 * 60));
+             const seconds = Math.floor((diff % (1000 * 60)) / 1000);
+             
+             countdownEl.textContent = `${days}d ${String(hours).padStart(2, '0')}:${String(minutes).padStart(2, '0')}:${String(seconds).padStart(2, '0')}`;
+         }
+ 
+         // Work Timer Functions
+         function startTimer() {
+             if (!isTimerRunning) {
+                 isTimerRunning = true;
+                 document.getElementById('startBtn').style.display = 'none';
+                 document.getElementById('stopBtn').style.display = 'block';
+                 
+                 timerInterval = setInterval(() => {
+                     timerSeconds++;
+                     updateTimerDisplay();
+                     updateCurrentSessionEarnings();
+                 }, 1000);
+             }
+         }
+ 
+         function stopTimer() {
+             if (isTimerRunning) {
+                 isTimerRunning = false;
+                 clearInterval(timerInterval);
+                 document.getElementById('startBtn').style.display = 'block';
+                 document.getElementById('stopBtn').style.display = 'none';
+                 logSession();
+             }
+         }
+ 
+         function resetTimer() {
+             if (isTimerRunning) stopTimer();
+             timerSeconds = 0;
+             updateTimerDisplay();
+             updateCurrentSessionEarnings();
+         }
+ 
+         function updateTimerDisplay() {
+             const hours = Math.floor(timerSeconds / 3600);
+             const minutes = Math.floor((timerSeconds % 3600) / 60);
+             const seconds = timerSeconds % 60;
+             const timerDisplayEl = document.getElementById('timerDisplay');
+             if (timerDisplayEl) {
+                 timerDisplayEl.textContent = `${String(hours).padStart(2, '0')}:${String(minutes).padStart(2, '0')}:${String(seconds).padStart(2, '0')}`;
+             }
+         }
+ 
+         function updateCurrentSessionEarnings() {
+             const rateEl = document.getElementById('hourlyRate');
+             if (!rateEl) return;
+             const rate = parseFloat(rateEl.value);
+             const hours = timerSeconds / 3600;
+             const earnings = hours * rate;
+             const earningsEl = document.getElementById('currentSessionEarnings');
+             if (earningsEl) earningsEl.textContent = `$${earnings.toFixed(2)}`;
+         }
+ 
+         async function logSession() {
+             if (timerSeconds === 0) return;
+             
+             const rateEl = document.getElementById('hourlyRate');
+             if (!rateEl) return;
+             
+             const rate = parseFloat(rateEl.value);
+             const hours = timerSeconds / 3600;
+             const earnings = hours * rate;
+             const isLeisure = rate === 0;
+             const opportunityCost = isLeisure ? hours * 24 : 0;
+             const note = prompt('Add a note for this session (optional):') || '';
+             
+             const startTime = new Date(Date.now() - timerSeconds * 1000);
+             const endTime = new Date();
+             
+             const sessionData = {
+                 time_display: `${startTime.toLocaleTimeString('en-US', { hour: 'numeric', minute: '2-digit', hour12: true })} - ${endTime.toLocaleTimeString('en-US', { hour: 'numeric', minute: '2-digit', hour12: true })}`,
+                 timestamp: startTime.toISOString(),
+                 date: startTime.toISOString().split('T')[0],
+                 hours: parseFloat(hours.toFixed(2)),
+                 rate: rate,
+                 earnings: parseFloat(earnings.toFixed(2)),
+                 note: note,
+                 is_leisure: isLeisure,
+                 opportunity_cost: parseFloat(opportunityCost.toFixed(2)),
+                 is_manual: false
+             };
+ 
+             try {
+                 await window.api.createSession(sessionData);
+                 await loadDashboardData();
+                 
+                 timerSeconds = 0;
+                 updateTimerDisplay();
+                 updateCurrentSessionEarnings();
+             } catch (error) {
+                 alert('Error saving session: ' + error.message);
+             }
+         }
+ 
+         // Load Sessions
+         async function loadSessions() {
+             try {
+                 sessions = await window.api.getSessions();
+                 updateSessionHistory();
+                 updateStats();
+             } catch (error) {
+                 console.error('Error loading sessions:', error);
+                 document.getElementById('sessionHistory').innerHTML = `
+                     <div class="empty-state">
+                         <p style="color: #dc3545;">Error loading sessions</p>
+                     </div>
+                 `;
+             }
+         }
+ 
+         // Load Bills
+         async function loadBills() {
+             try {
+                 bills = await window.api.getBills();
+                 renderBills();
+                 updateStats();
+             } catch (error) {
+                 console.error('Error loading bills:', error);
+                 document.getElementById('billsTrack').innerHTML = `
+                     <div class="empty-state">
+                         <p style="color: #dc3545;">Error loading bills</p>
+                     </div>
+                 `;
+             }
+         }
+ 
+         // Render Bills with Urgency
+         function renderBills() {
+             const now = new Date();
+             const track = document.getElementById('billsTrack');
+             if (!track) return;
+             
+             if (bills.length === 0) {
+                 track.innerHTML = `
+                     <div class="empty-state">
+                         <div class="empty-state-icon">📭</div>
+                         <p>No bills tracked yet</p>
+                     </div>
+                 `;
+                 return;
+             }
+             
+             const sortedBills = [...bills].sort((a, b) => {
+                 if (a.paid && !b.paid) return 1;
+                 if (!a.paid && b.paid) return -1;
+                 if (!a.due_date) return 1;
+                 if (!b.due_date) return -1;
+                 return new Date(a.due_date) - new Date(b.due_date);
+             });
+             
+             track.innerHTML = sortedBills.map(bill => {
+                 const dueDate = bill.due_date ? new Date(bill.due_date) : null;
+                 const daysUntil = dueDate ? Math.ceil((dueDate - now) / (1000 * 60 * 60 * 24)) : null;
+                 let urgencyClass = '';
+                 let dueText = '';
+                 
+                 if (bill.paid) {
+                     urgencyClass = 'paid';
+                     dueText = '✅ PAID';
+                 } else if (!dueDate) {
+                     urgencyClass = '';
+                     dueText = 'No due date';
+                 } else if (daysUntil < 0) {
+                     urgencyClass = 'urgent';
+                     dueText = `⚠️ OVERDUE by ${Math.abs(daysUntil)} days`;
+                 } else if (daysUntil === 0) {
+                     urgencyClass = 'urgent';
+                     dueText = '🔴 DUE TODAY';
+                 } else if (daysUntil <= 3) {
+                     urgencyClass = 'urgent';
+                     dueText = `🔴 Due in ${daysUntil} days`;
+                 } else if (daysUntil <= 7) {
+                     urgencyClass = 'warning';
+                     dueText = `🟡 Due in ${daysUntil} days`;
+                 } else {
+                     dueText = `Due ${dueDate.toLocaleDateString('en-US', { month: 'short', day: 'numeric' })}`;
+                 }
+                 
+                 return `
+                     <div class="bill-item ${urgencyClass}">
+                         <div class="bill-info">
+                             <div class="bill-name">${bill.name}</div>
+                             <div class="bill-due ${urgencyClass === 'urgent' || urgencyClass === 'warning' ? 'urgent' : ''}">${dueText}</div>
+                         </div>
+                         <div class="bill-amount ${bill.paid ? 'paid' : ''}">
+                             $${parseFloat(bill.amount_cad).toFixed(2)}
+                             <span class="bill-amount-usd">~$${Math.round(parseFloat(bill.amount_usd))} USD</span>
+                         </div>
+                         <div class="session-actions">
+                             <button class="action-btn" onclick="toggleBillPaid(${bill.id}, ${!bill.paid})">${bill.paid ? 'Unpaid' : 'Paid'}</button>
+                             <button class="action-btn delete" onclick="deleteBill(${bill.id})">🗑️</button>
+                         </div>
+                     </div>
+                 `;
+             }).join('');
+             
+             const totalUnpaidCAD = sortedBills.filter(b => !b.paid).reduce((sum, b) => sum + parseFloat(b.amount_cad), 0);
+             const billsTotalEl = document.getElementById('billsTotal');
+             if (billsTotalEl) billsTotalEl.textContent = `$${totalUnpaidCAD.toFixed(2)}`;
+         }
+ 
+         // Update Session History
+         function updateSessionHistory() {
+             const container = document.getElementById('sessionHistory');
+             if (!container) return;
+             
+             const viewDateInput = document.getElementById('viewDate');
+             const viewDateValue = viewDateInput ? viewDateInput.value : null;
+             
+             let filteredSessions = sessions;
+             let viewingAll = false;
+             
+             if (viewDateValue) {
+                 const viewDate = new Date(viewDateValue).toDateString();
+                 filteredSessions = sessions.filter(s => new Date(s.timestamp).toDateString() === viewDate);
+             } else {
+                 viewingAll = true;
+             }
+             
+             if (filteredSessions.length === 0) {
+                 container.innerHTML = `<div class="empty-state"><div class="empty-state-icon">📭</div><p>${viewingAll ? 'No sessions logged yet' : 'No sessions on this date'}</p></div>`;
+                 return;
+             }
+             
+             if (viewingAll) {
+                 const sessionsByDate = {};
+                 filteredSessions.forEach(s => {
+                     const date = new Date(s.timestamp).toDateString();
+                     if (!sessionsByDate[date]) sessionsByDate[date] = [];
+                     sessionsByDate[date].push(s);
+                 });
+                 
+                 container.innerHTML = Object.keys(sessionsByDate)
+                     .sort((a, b) => new Date(b) - new Date(a))
+                     .map(date => {
+                         const dateSessions = sessionsByDate[date];
+                         const totalHours = dateSessions.reduce((sum, s) => sum + parseFloat(s.hours), 0);
+                         const totalEarnings = dateSessions.filter(s => !s.is_leisure).reduce((sum, s) => sum + parseFloat(s.earnings), 0);
+                         
+                         return `
+                             <div class="date-group-header">
+                                 <span>${new Date(date).toLocaleDateString('en-US', { weekday: 'short', month: 'short', day: 'numeric', year: 'numeric' })}</span>
+                                 <span class="date-group-stats">${totalHours.toFixed(1)}h • $${totalEarnings.toFixed(0)}</span>
+                             </div>
+                             ${renderSessionItems(dateSessions)}
+                         `;
+                     }).join('');
+             } else {
+                 container.innerHTML = renderSessionItems(filteredSessions);
+             }
+         }
+         
+         function renderSessionItems(sessionList) {
+             return sessionList.map((s) => {
+                 const isLeisure = s.rate === 0 || s.is_leisure;
+                 const displayEarnings = isLeisure ? 
+                     `-$${(s.opportunity_cost || (parseFloat(s.hours) * 24)).toFixed(2)}` :
+                     `$${parseFloat(s.earnings).toFixed(2)}`;
+                 
+                 return `
+                     <div class="session-item ${isLeisure ? 'leisure' : ''}">
+                         <div class="session-info">
+                             <div class="session-time">
+                                 ${s.time_display || new Date(s.timestamp).toLocaleString()}
+                                 ${isLeisure ? '<span style="font-size: 1.2em;">🎮</span>' : ''}
+                                 ${s.is_manual ? '<span class="badge manual">MANUAL</span>' : ''}
+                             </div>
+                             <div class="session-details">${s.hours}h @ $${s.rate}/hr</div>
+                             ${s.note ? `<div class="session-note">${s.note}</div>` : ''}
+                         </div>
+                         <div class="session-earnings ${isLeisure ? 'negative' : ''}">${displayEarnings}</div>
+                         <div class="session-actions">
+                             <button class="action-btn" onclick="editSession(${s.id})">✏️</button>
+                             <button class="action-btn delete" onclick="deleteSession(${s.id})">🗑️</button>
+                         </div>
+                     </div>
+                 `;
+             }).join('');
+         }
+ 
+         function viewToday() {
+             const viewDateEl = document.getElementById('viewDate');
+             if (viewDateEl) viewDateEl.valueAsDate = new Date();
+             updateSessionHistory();
+         }
+         
+         function viewAllDays() {
+             const viewDateEl = document.getElementById('viewDate');
+             if (viewDateEl) viewDateEl.value = '';
+             updateSessionHistory();
+         }
+ 
+         // Load and Update Stats
+         async function loadStats() {
+             try {
+                 const stats = await window.api.getStats();
+                 const todayStats = await window.api.getTodayStats();
+                 
+                 TOTAL_NEEDED = stats.totalTarget;
+                 
+                 updateStatsDisplay(stats, todayStats);
+             } catch (error) {
+                 console.error('Error loading stats:', error);
+             }
+         }
+ 
+         function updateStats() {
+             if (sessions.length === 0 && bills.length === 0) return;
+             
+             const today = new Date().toDateString();
+             const todaySessions = sessions.filter(s => new Date(s.timestamp).toDateString() === today);
+             
+             const todayHours = todaySessions.reduce((sum, s) => sum + parseFloat(s.hours), 0);
+             const todayEarnings = todaySessions.filter(s => !s.is_leisure).reduce((sum, s) => sum + parseFloat(s.earnings), 0);
+             
+             const totalEarned = sessions.filter(s => !s.is_leisure).reduce((sum, s) => sum + parseFloat(s.earnings), 0);
+             
+             const totalBillsUSD = bills.filter(b => !b.paid).reduce((sum, b) => sum + parseFloat(b.amount_usd), 0);
+             const totalBillsCAD = bills.filter(b => !b.paid).reduce((sum, b) => sum + parseFloat(b.amount_cad), 0);
+             const totalWithTax = totalBillsUSD / 0.67;
+             
+             const remaining = totalWithTax - totalEarned;
+             const daysLeft = Math.max(1, Math.ceil((DEADLINE - new Date()) / (1000 * 60 * 60 * 24)));
+             const dailyGoal = remaining / daysLeft;
+             
+             const rateEl = document.getElementById('hourlyRate');
+             const rate = rateEl ? parseFloat(rateEl.value) : 24;
+             const hoursPerDay = rate > 0 ? dailyGoal / rate : 0;
+             const totalHours = rate > 0 ? remaining / rate : 0;
+             
+             const progress = (totalEarned / totalWithTax) * 100;
+             const todayProgress = (todayEarnings / dailyGoal) * 100;
+             
+             const els = {
+                 dailyGoal: document.getElementById('dailyGoal'),
+                 todayProgress: document.getElementById('todayProgress'),
+                 todayProgressText: document.getElementById('todayProgressText'),
+                 todayStatus: document.getElementById('todayStatus'),
+                 totalEarned: document.getElementById('totalEarned'),
+                 totalNeeded: document.getElementById('totalNeeded'),
+                 sprintProgress: document.getElementById('sprintProgress'),
+                 sprintProgressText: document.getElementById('sprintProgressText'),
+                 remaining: document.getElementById('remaining'),
+                 daysLeft: document.getElementById('daysLeft'),
+                 todayHours: document.getElementById('todayHours'),
+                 todayEarnings: document.getElementById('todayEarnings'),
+                 hoursNeeded: document.getElementById('hoursNeeded'),
+                 totalHoursNeeded: document.getElementById('totalHoursNeeded'),
+                 billsTotalCAD: document.getElementById('billsTotalCAD'),
+                 billsTotalUSD: document.getElementById('billsTotalUSD'),
+                 billsWithTax: document.getElementById('billsWithTax'),
+                 billsCovered: document.getElementById('billsCovered')
+             };
+             
+             if (els.dailyGoal) els.dailyGoal.textContent = `$${Math.round(dailyGoal)}`;
+             if (els.todayProgress) {
+                 els.todayProgress.style.width = Math.min(todayProgress, 100) + '%';
+                 els.todayProgress.classList.toggle('behind', todayProgress < 100);
+             }
+             if (els.todayProgressText) els.todayProgressText.textContent = `$${Math.round(todayEarnings)} / $${Math.round(dailyGoal)}`;
+             
+             if (els.todayStatus) {
+                 if (todayEarnings >= dailyGoal) {
+                     els.todayStatus.textContent = `✅ GOAL MET! +$${(todayEarnings - dailyGoal).toFixed(2)} extra`;
+                     els.todayStatus.className = 'status-message status-ahead';
+                 } else {
+                     const needed = dailyGoal - todayEarnings;
+                     els.todayStatus.textContent = `You need $${needed.toFixed(2)} more today`;
+                     els.todayStatus.className = 'status-message status-behind';
+                 }
+             }
+             
+             if (els.totalEarned) els.totalEarned.textContent = `$${Math.round(totalEarned)}`;
+             if (els.totalNeeded) els.totalNeeded.textContent = Math.round(totalWithTax);
+             if (els.sprintProgress) els.sprintProgress.style.width = Math.min(progress, 100) + '%';
+             if (els.sprintProgressText) els.sprintProgressText.textContent = Math.round(progress) + '%';
+             if (els.remaining) els.remaining.textContent = `$${Math.round(remaining)}`;
+             if (els.daysLeft) els.daysLeft.textContent = daysLeft;
+             if (els.todayHours) els.todayHours.textContent = todayHours.toFixed(1);
+             if (els.todayEarnings) els.todayEarnings.textContent = `$${Math.round(todayEarnings)}`;
+             if (els.hoursNeeded) els.hoursNeeded.textContent = hoursPerDay.toFixed(1);
+             if (els.totalHoursNeeded) els.totalHoursNeeded.textContent = Math.round(totalHours);
+             
+             if (els.billsTotalCAD) els.billsTotalCAD.textContent = `$${Math.round(totalBillsCAD)}`;
+             if (els.billsTotalUSD) els.billsTotalUSD.textContent = `$${Math.round(totalBillsUSD)}`;
+             if (els.billsWithTax) els.billsWithTax.textContent = `$${Math.round(totalWithTax)}`;
+             if (els.billsCovered) els.billsCovered.textContent = `${Math.round(progress)}%`;
+         }
+ 
+         function updateStatsDisplay(stats, todayStats) {
+             // This will be called from loadStats with API data
+             updateStats(); // Reuse the local calculation logic
+         }
+ 
+         // Burger Menu
+         function toggleBurgerMenu() {
+             const menu = document.getElementById('burgerMenu');
+             const overlay = document.getElementById('burgerOverlay');
+             menu.classList.toggle('open');
+             overlay.classList.toggle('show');
+         }
+ 
+         function closeBurgerMenu() {
+             document.getElementById('burgerMenu').classList.remove('open');
+             document.getElementById('burgerOverlay').classList.remove('show');
+         }
+ 
+         // Modal Functions
+         function showAddSessionModal() {
+             document.getElementById('addSessionModal').classList.add('show');
+         }
+ 
+         function closeAddSessionModal() {
+             document.getElementById('addSessionModal').classList.remove('show');
+         }
+ 
+         function showAddBillModal() {
+             document.getElementById('addBillModal').classList.add('show');
+         }
+ 
+         function closeAddBillModal() {
+             document.getElementById('addBillModal').classList.remove('show');
+         }
+ 
+         // Add Manual Session
+         async function addManualSession(event) {
+             event.preventDefault();
+             
+             const dateInput = document.getElementById('manualDate').value;
+             const startTime = document.getElementById('manualStartTime').value;
+             const endTime = document.getElementById('manualEndTime').value;
+             const rate = parseFloat(document.getElementById('manualRate').value);
+             const note = document.getElementById('manualNote').value;
+             
+             if (!dateInput || !startTime || !endTime) {
+                 alert('Please fill in Date, Start Time, and End Time');
+                 return;
+             }
+             
+             const entryDate = new Date(dateInput);
+             const [startHour, startMinute] = startTime.split(':').map(Number);
+             const [endHour, endMinute] = endTime.split(':').map(Number);
+             
+             let startTotalMinutes = startHour * 60 + startMinute;
+             let endTotalMinutes = endHour * 60 + endMinute;
+             if (endTotalMinutes <= startTotalMinutes) endTotalMinutes += 24 * 60;
+             
+             const hours = (endTotalMinutes - startTotalMinutes) / 60;
+             
+             const startTimeFormatted = new Date(entryDate);
+             startTimeFormatted.setHours(startHour, startMinute);
+             const endTimeFormatted = new Date(entryDate);
+             endTimeFormatted.setHours(endHour, endMinute);
+             
+             const timeDisplay = `${startTimeFormatted.toLocaleTimeString('en-US', { hour: 'numeric', minute: '2-digit', hour12: true })} - ${endTimeFormatted.toLocaleTimeString('en-US', { hour: 'numeric', minute: '2-digit', hour12: true })}`;
+             
+             const isLeisure = rate === 0;
+             const earnings = isLeisure ? 0 : hours * rate;
+             const opportunityCost = isLeisure ? hours * 24 : 0;
+             
+             const sessionData = {
+                 time_display: timeDisplay,
+                 timestamp: entryDate.toISOString(),
+                 date: entryDate.toISOString().split('T')[0],
+                 hours: parseFloat(hours.toFixed(2)),
+                 rate: rate,
+                 earnings: parseFloat(earnings.toFixed(2)),
+                 note: note,
+                 is_leisure: isLeisure,
+                 opportunity_cost: parseFloat(opportunityCost.toFixed(2)),
+                 is_manual: true
+             };
+ 
+             try {
+                 await window.api.createSession(sessionData);
+                 await loadDashboardData();
+                 closeAddSessionModal();
+                 
+                 // Reset form
+                 document.getElementById('manualStartTime').value = '';
+                 document.getElementById('manualEndTime').value = '';
+                 document.getElementById('manualNote').value = '';
+             } catch (error) {
+                 alert('Error adding session: ' + error.message);
+             }
+         }
+ 
+         // Add Bill
+         async function addBill(event) {
+             event.preventDefault();
+ 
+             const name = document.getElementById('billName').value;
+             const amountCAD = parseFloat(document.getElementById('billAmountCAD').value);
+             const amountUSD = parseFloat(document.getElementById('billAmountUSD').value);
+             const dueDate = document.getElementById('billDueDate').value;
+ 
+             const billData = {
+                 name: name,
+                 amount_cad: amountCAD,
+                 amount_usd: amountUSD,
+                 due_date: dueDate || null
+             };
+ 
+             try {
+                 await window.api.createBill(billData);
+                 await loadDashboardData();
+                 closeAddBillModal();
+                 
+                 // Reset form
+                 document.getElementById('billName').value = '';
+                 document.getElementById('billAmountCAD').value = '';
+                 document.getElementById('billAmountUSD').value = '';
+                 document.getElementById('billDueDate').value = '';
+             } catch (error) {
+                 alert('Error adding bill: ' + error.message);
+             }
+         }
+ 
+         function autoCalculateUSD() {
+             const cadInput = document.getElementById('billAmountCAD');
+             const usdInput = document.getElementById('billAmountUSD');
+             
+             if (cadInput && usdInput && cadInput.value) {
+                 const cad = parseFloat(cadInput.value);
+                 const usd = (cad / 1.4).toFixed(2);
+                 usdInput.value = usd;
+             }
+         }
+ 
+         // Edit Session
+         async function editSession(id) {
+             const session = sessions.find(s => s.id === id);
+             if (!session) return;
+             
+             const newRate = prompt(`Edit hourly rate (was $${session.rate}/hr):`, session.rate);
+             if (newRate === null) return;
+             
+             const rate = parseFloat(newRate);
+             if (isNaN(rate) || rate < 0) {
+                 alert('Please enter a valid rate (0 or higher)');
+                 return;
+             }
+             
+             const newNote = prompt(`Edit note (optional):`, session.note || '');
+             const hours = parseFloat(session.hours);
+             const isLeisure = rate === 0;
+             const newEarnings = isLeisure ? 0 : hours * rate;
+             const opportunityCost = isLeisure ? hours * 24 : 0;
+             
+             try {
+                 await window.api.updateSession(id, {
+                     rate: rate,
+                     earnings: newEarnings,
+                     note: newNote,
+                     is_leisure: isLeisure,
+                     opportunity_cost: opportunityCost
+                 });
+                 await loadDashboardData();
+             } catch (error) {
+                 alert('Error updating session: ' + error.message);
+             }
+         }
+ 
+         // Delete Session
+         async function deleteSession(id) {
+             if (!confirm('Delete this session?')) return;
+             
+             try {
+                 await window.api.deleteSession(id);
+                 await loadDashboardData();
+             } catch (error) {
+                 alert('Error deleting session: ' + error.message);
+             }
+         }
+ 
+         // Toggle Bill Paid
+         async function toggleBillPaid(id, paid) {
+             try {
+                 await window.api.markBillPaid(id, paid);
+                 await loadBills();
+             } catch (error) {
+                 alert('Error updating bill: ' + error.message);
+             }
+         }
+ 
+         // Delete Bill
+         async function deleteBill(id) {
+             if (!confirm('Delete this bill?')) return;
+             
+             try {
+                 // Note: Need to add deleteBill to API
+                 const response = await window.api.request(`/api/bills/${id}`, {
+                     method: 'DELETE'
+                 });
+                 await loadDashboardData();
+             } catch (error) {
+                 alert('Error deleting bill: ' + error.message);
+             }
+         }
+ 
+         // Export Data
+         async function exportData() {
+             try {
+                 const data = await window.api.exportData();
+                 const blob = new Blob([JSON.stringify(data, null, 2)], { type: 'application/json' });
+                 const url = URL.createObjectURL(blob);
+                 const a = document.createElement('a');
+                 a.href = url;
+                 a.download = `survival-dashboard-export-${new Date().toISOString().split('T')[0]}.json`;
+                 document.body.appendChild(a);
+                 a.click();
+                 document.body.removeChild(a);
+                 URL.revokeObjectURL(url);
+                 closeBurgerMenu();
+             } catch (error) {
+                 alert('Error exporting data: ' + error.message);
+             }
+         }
+ 
+         // Import Data
+         function importData() {
+             document.getElementById('importFile').click();
+             closeBurgerMenu();
+         }
+ 
+         function handleImport(event) {
+             const file = event.target.files[0];
+             if (!file) return;
+             
+             const reader = new FileReader();
+             reader.onload = async function(e) {
+                 try {
+                     const data = JSON.parse(e.target.result);
+                     // Handle import logic here
+                     alert('Import functionality coming soon!');
+                 } catch (err) {
+                     alert('❌ Error importing data: ' + err.message);
+                 }
+             };
+             reader.readAsText(file);
+             event.target.value = '';
+         }
+ 
+         // Logout
+         function handleLogout() {
+             if (confirm('Are you sure you want to logout?')) {
+                 localStorage.removeItem('authToken');
+                 window.location.href = '/login.html';
+             }
+         }
+ 
+         // Close modals on outside click
+         document.getElementById('addSessionModal').addEventListener('click', (e) => {
+             if (e.target.id === 'addSessionModal') closeAddSessionModal();
+         });
+ 
+         document.getElementById('addBillModal').addEventListener('click', (e) => {
+             if (e.target.id === 'addBillModal') closeAddBillModal();
+         });
+ 
+         // ESC key to close
+         document.addEventListener('keydown', (e) => {
+             if (e.key === 'Escape') {
+                 closeBurgerMenu();
+                 closeAddSessionModal();
+                 closeAddBillModal();
+             }
+         });
+     </script>
+ </body>
+ </html>
+ 
```

## ✅ **Import/Export Functionality is Now Complete!**

I've implemented the full import functionality that will import your data from the local HTML version into the database!

---

## 🎯 **What I Just Built:**

### **Import Features:**

1. **Smart Format Detection**
   - Handles the old local HTML format (with fields like `time`, `isLeisure`, `opportunityCost`)
   - Handles the new API export format
   - Automatically maps between formats

2. **Data Validation**
   - Checks if the JSON file is valid
   - Validates data structure
   - Asks for confirmation before adding to existing data

3. **Session Import**
   - Maps all session fields correctly:
     - `time` or `time_display` → `time_display`
     - `isLeisure` or `is_leisure` → `is_leisure`
     - `opportunityCost` → `opportunity_cost`
   - Handles missing dates/timestamps gracefully
   - All imported sessions marked as `is_manual: true`

4. **Bill Import** (if your file has bills)
   - Maps bill fields:
     - `amount` or `amount_cad` → `amount_cad`
     - `amountUSD` or `amount_usd` → `amount_usd`
     - `dueDate` or `due_date` → `due_date`
   - Auto-calculates USD if missing (CAD ÷ 1.4)

5. **Detailed Results**
   - Shows count of imported sessions
   - Shows count of imported bills
   - Shows count of skipped items (if errors)
   - Reloads dashboard automatically

6. **Error Handling**
   - Skips invalid sessions/bills instead of failing completely
   - Logs errors to console for debugging
   - Shows user-friendly error messages

## 📥 **How to Use It:**

### **Step 1: Export from Your Local HTML**
On your old local HTML file:
1. Click the "📤 Export Data" button
2. Save the JSON file (e.g., `survival-dashboard-2025-10-17.json`)

### **Step 2: Import to Database**
On your new deployed app:
1. Click the **☰** burger menu (top right)
2. Click **"📤 Import Data"**
3. Select your exported JSON file
4. Confirm the import (it shows you how many sessions/bills you currently have)
5. Wait for import to complete
6. See success message with details!

## 📝 **ISSUE 1: Limited Edit Functionality**

### **Proposed Solution: Edit Modal/Slide Panel**

**UX Decision:** **Modal (not slide panel)** is better because:
- ✅ Focuses user attention on single task
- ✅ Blocks background interactions (prevents accidental clicks)
- ✅ Familiar pattern for editing
- ✅ Works better on mobile (full screen takeover)
- ✅ Can show all fields at once with scrolling

#### **B. Smart Calculations**

**New Calculation Flow:**
```javascript
// 1. Get sprint end date (from settings or default)
sprintEndDate = userSettings.sprintEndDate || DEFAULT_DEADLINE;

// 2. Calculate days left
daysLeft = Math.max(1, Math.ceil((sprintEndDate - now) / DAY_MS));

// 3. Get target amount
if (bills.length > 0) {
    // Sum unpaid bills (USD) + tax reserve
    totalBillsUSD = bills.filter(b => !b.paid)
                         .reduce((sum, b) => sum + b.amount_usd, 0);
    targetWithTax = totalBillsUSD / (1 - taxRate); // e.g., /0.67 for 33% tax
} else {
    // No bills: use manual target or 0
    targetWithTax = userSettings.manualTarget || 0;
}

// 4. Calculate remaining
totalEarned = sessions.filter(s => !s.is_leisure)
                     .reduce((sum, s) => sum + s.earnings, 0);
remaining = targetWithTax - totalEarned;

// 5. Calculate daily goal
dailyGoal = Math.max(0, remaining / daysLeft);

// 6. Calculate hours needed
hoursPerDay = dailyGoal / hourlyRate;
totalHoursNeeded = remaining / hourlyRate;

// 7. Calculate progress
progress = targetWithTax > 0 ? (totalEarned / targetWithTax * 100) : 0;
```

#### **C. Empty State Handling**

**When No Bills Exist:**
```
┌─────────────────────────────────┐
│  💸 BILLS CONVEYOR              │
├─────────────────────────────────┤
│  📭 No bills tracked yet        │
│                                 │
│  [➕ Add First Bill]             │
│  [📤 Import Bills (CSV)]         │
│                                 │
│  Or set a manual target in      │
│  Sprint Settings                │
└─────────────────────────────────┘
```

**Today's Goal Card (when no target):**

## 🎯 **ISSUE 4: Sprint Completion Behavior**

### **Current Problem:**
- ❌ Progress bar hits 100% or >100%... then what?

### **Proposed Solutions:**

#### **Option A: Auto-Rollover (Recommended)**

**When progress >= 100%:**
```
┌─────────────────────────────────┐
│  🎉 Sprint Complete!            │
├─────────────────────────────────┤
│  You earned $3,200 of $2,945!   │
│  Surplus: $255                  │
│                                 │
│  What would you like to do?     │
│                                 │
│  ○ Start New Sprint             │
│    Next 9 days with new bills   │
│                                 │
│  ○ Mark Bills Paid & Continue   │
│    Keep tracking earnings       │
│                                 │
│  ○ Extend Current Sprint        │
│    Add [7] more days            │
│                                 │
│  [Continue]                     │
└─────────────────────────────────┘
```

#### **Option B: Visual Indicator Only**

**When >= 100%:**
- Progress bar turns gold/green
- Shows "✅ TARGET MET!" badge
- Still shows stats
- No modal popup (less intrusive)
- User can manually configure new sprint when ready

#### **My Recommendation: Hybrid Approach**

1. **First time hitting 100%**: Show celebration modal (Option A)
2. **Subsequent times**: Just show badge (Option B)
3. **Always available**: "⚙️ Sprint Settings" in burger menu

```sql
    sprint_end_date DATE NOT NULL DEFAULT '2025-10-24',
    default_hourly_rate DECIMAL(10, 2) DEFAULT 24.00,
    tax_reserve_rate DECIMAL(5, 2) DEFAULT 0.33,

);

CREATE INDEX idx_user_settings_user_id ON user_settings(user_id);
```

## 🎨 **UX/UI DESIGN PRINCIPLES APPLIED**

### **1. Progressive Disclosure**
- Don't show all settings upfront
- Settings in burger menu (available but not intrusive)
- Defaults work for 90% of users

### **2. Smart Defaults**
- Auto-calculate from bills (most common case)
- Fallback to manual target (flexibility)
- Sensible defaults (24/hr, 33% tax, 1.4 CAD/USD)

### **3. Feedback & Validation**
- Show what will be imported before confirming
- Validate CSV format with helpful errors
- Auto-calculate dependent fields

### **4. Error Prevention**
- Empty states with clear calls-to-action
- No division by zero (max(1, daysLeft))
- Handle missing data gracefully

### **5. Efficiency**
- Bulk import for multiple bills
- CSV format (Excel/Sheets compatible)
- Edit modal shows all fields at once

### **6. Flexibility**
- Both automatic and manual targets
- Configurable rates and dates
- Export/import for data portability

## 🎯 **SPECIFIC CALCULATION FIXES**

### **Current Bugs:**
```javascript
// Bug 1: Negative daily goal when ahead
dailyGoal = remaining / daysLeft;  // Can be negative!

// Bug 2: Infinity when no target
progress = earned / target * 100;  // target = 0 = Infinity!

// Bug 3: Division by zero
hoursNeeded = dailyGoal / rate;    // rate could be 0
```

### **Fixed Calculations:**
```javascript
// Fix 1: Daily goal can't be negative (you're ahead!)
dailyGoal = Math.max(0, remaining / daysLeft);
statusMessage = remaining > 0 
    ? `You need $${remaining.toFixed(2)} more`
    : `✅ You're $${Math.abs(remaining).toFixed(2)} ahead!`;

// Fix 2: Handle no target case
progress = target > 0 ? (earned / target * 100) : 0;
// Or show different UI entirely when target = 0

// Fix 3: Safe division
hoursNeeded = rate > 0 ? (dailyGoal / rate) : 0;
```

---

## 📊 **UPDATED CARD LOGIC**

### **Today's Goal Card:**
```javascript
if (target === 0) {
    // No target set
    show "Configure Sprint" button
} else if (remaining <= 0) {
    // Goal met or exceeded
    show "✅ TARGET MET! $X ahead"
    progress bar = 100% (green)
} else {
    // Still working toward goal
    show "You need $X more today"
    progress bar = current progress
}
```

### **9-Day Sprint Card:**
```javascript
// Update title dynamically
const daysLeft = Math.ceil((sprintEnd - now) / DAY_MS);
title = `📊 ${daysLeft}-DAY SPRINT`;

// Handle progress display
if (target === 0) {
    show "No target - [Set Target]"
} else if (progress >= 100) {
    show "✅ COMPLETE - $X of $Y (${Math.round(progress)}%)"
    consider showing celebration
} else {
    show "$X of $Y (${Math.round(progress)}%)"
}
```

**Celebration Modal includes:**
- 🎉 Confetti animation

- Options for next action

```diff
+ app.post('/api/bills/import-csv',
+   authenticateToken,

+     body('csvData').isString().notEmpty()

+   handleValidationErrors,
+   async (req, res) => {
+     try {
+       const { csvData } = req.body;
+       const lines = csvData.split('\n').filter(line => line.trim());
+       
+       if (lines.length < 2) {
+         return res.status(400).json({ error: 'CSV file is empty or invalid' });
+       }
+ 
+       // Skip header line
+       const dataLines = lines.slice(1);
+       const imported = [];
+       const errors = [];
+ 
+       for (let i = 0; i < dataLines.length; i++) {
+         const line = dataLines[i];
+         // Simple CSV parsing (handles quoted fields)
+         const matches = line.match(/(".*?"|[^,]+)(?=\s*,|\s*$)/g);
+         
+         if (!matches || matches.length < 5) {
+           errors.push({ line: i + 2, error: 'Invalid CSV format' });
+           continue;
+         }
+ 
+         const [name, amountCAD, amountUSD, dueDate, paid] = matches.map(m => m.replace(/^"|"$/g, '').trim());
+ 
+         try {
+           const result = await pool.query(
+             `INSERT INTO bills (user_id, name, amount_cad, amount_usd, due_date, paid)
+              VALUES ($1, $2, $3, $4, $5, $6)
+              RETURNING *`,
+             [
+               req.user.id,
+               name || 'Imported Bill',
+               parseFloat(amountCAD) || 0,
+               parseFloat(amountUSD) || 0,
+               dueDate || null,
+               paid?.toLowerCase() === 'yes' || paid?.toLowerCase() === 'true'
+             ]
+           );
+           imported.push(result.rows[0]);
+         } catch (error) {
+           console.error(`Error importing bill line ${i + 2}:`, error);
+           errors.push({ line: i + 2, error: error.message });
+         }
+       }
+ 
+       res.json({
+         message: 'Import completed',
+         imported: imported.length,
+         errors: errors.length,
+         details: errors
+       });
+     } catch (error) {
+       console.error('CSV import error:', error);
+       res.status(500).json({ error: 'Failed to import bills from CSV' });
+     }
+   }
+ );
```

```diff
+         async function handleBillsCsvImport(event) {

+                             'Continue with import?'

+                     }
+                     
+                     const result = await window.api.importBillsCSV(csvData);
```

Perfect! I've completed all the business logic improvements from our design meeting. Here's what has been implemented:

## ✅ Completed Implementations

### 1. **Database Schema Updates**
- Added `user_settings` table with fields for:
  - Sprint end date/time
  - Target bills mode (auto unpaid/auto all/manual)
  - Manual target amount
  - Default hourly rate
  - Tax reserve rate
  - CAD to USD exchange rate

### 2. **Backend API Enhancements**
- `GET/PUT /api/settings` - User settings management
- `GET /api/bills/export-csv` - Export bills as CSV
- `POST /api/bills/import-csv` - Import bills from CSV
- Enhanced session editing endpoint (already supported all fields)

### 3. **Frontend Features Added**

**Sprint Settings Modal (⚙️):**
- Configure sprint deadline dynamically
- Choose target calculation mode (auto unpaid/auto all/manual)
- Set default hourly rate
- Set tax reserve rate
- Set exchange rate

**Session Edit Modal (✏️):**
- Edit all session attributes (date, time, hours, rate, note, leisure status)
- Auto-calculate earnings based on inputs
- Replaces annoying popup prompts

**CSV Import/Export:**
- Export bills to CSV format
- Import bills from CSV with preview and error reporting
- Full validation and error handling

**Enhanced Calculations:**
- All dashboard calculations now use dynamic user settings
- Fixed progress bar edge cases (infinity%, negative values)
- Shows "🎉 COMPLETE!" when sprint target is met
- Shows surplus earnings when target is exceeded

### 4. **UX Improvements**
- Better visual feedback when sprint is complete
- Proper handling of edge cases (no bills, no target, etc.)
- All modals close with ESC key
- Click outside modal to close

## 🚀 Deployment Steps

**You need to do the following:**

1. **Update Database Schema** (in DBeaver or psql):
   ```sql
   -- Run these commands one by one in your survival_db database:
   
   CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS user_settings (
       id SERIAL PRIMARY KEY,
       user_id INTEGER NOT NULL UNIQUE REFERENCES users(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
       sprint_end_date TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE DEFAULT (CURRENT_TIMESTAMP + INTERVAL '9 days'),
       target_bills_mode VARCHAR(20) DEFAULT 'auto_unpaid' CHECK (target_bills_mode IN ('auto_unpaid', 'auto_all', 'manual')),
       target_bills_manual DECIMAL(10, 2) DEFAULT 0 CHECK (target_bills_manual >= 0),
       default_hourly_rate DECIMAL(10, 2) DEFAULT 55.00 CHECK (default_hourly_rate >= 0),
       tax_reserve_rate DECIMAL(5, 2) DEFAULT 30.00 CHECK (tax_reserve_rate >= 0 AND tax_reserve_rate <= 100),
       exchange_rate_cad_to_usd DECIMAL(10, 4) DEFAULT 0.7143 CHECK (exchange_rate_cad_to_usd > 0),
       created_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
       updated_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
       CONSTRAINT fk_user FOREIGN KEY (user_id) REFERENCES users(id) ON DELETE CASCADE
   );
   
   CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_user_settings_user_id ON user_settings(user_id);
   
   CREATE TRIGGER update_user_settings_updated_at BEFORE UPDATE ON user_settings
       FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION update_updated_at_column();
   ```

2. **Deploy Backend** (Render):
   - Your code is already committed locally
   - Push to GitHub: `git push origin main`
   - Render will auto-deploy the updated backend

3. **Deploy Frontend** (Netlify):
   - Push to GitHub: `git push origin main`
   - Netlify will auto-deploy the updated frontend

4. **Test the New Features:**
   - Log into your dashboard
   - Open the burger menu (☰)
   - Click "⚙️ Sprint Settings" to configure your sprint
   - Edit a session by clicking the ✏️ button
   - Try CSV import/export for bills
   - Verify dynamic calculations are working

All files have been updated and are ready to deploy! 🎉

+ # 🎯 CRITICAL FIX: updateStats() Type Coercion Issues
+ 
+ ## The Root Cause (You Were Right!)
+ 
+ The issue was indeed in `updateStats()` - it's called by both `loadSessions()` and `loadBills()`, so when it throws an error, both fail with "Error loading sessions" and "Error loading bills".
+ 
+ ## Type Coercion Bugs Found & Fixed
+ 
+ ### 1. **Missing `|| 0` Fallbacks on parseFloat()**
+ 
+ **The Problem:**
+ ```javascript
+ // BEFORE (lines 1873-1890)
+ const todayHours = todaySessions.reduce((sum, s) => sum + parseFloat(s.hours), 0);
+ const todayEarnings = todaySessions.filter(s => !s.is_leisure).reduce((sum, s) => sum + parseFloat(s.earnings), 0);
+ const sessionsEarned = sessions.filter(s => !s.is_leisure).reduce((sum, s) => sum + parseFloat(s.earnings), 0);
+ const totalBillsCAD = bills.filter(b => !b.paid).reduce((sum, b) => sum + parseFloat(b.amount_cad), 0);
+ ```
+ 
+ **Why It Fails:**
+ - If any session has `hours: null` → `parseFloat(null)` = `NaN`
+ - If any session has `earnings: undefined` → `parseFloat(undefined)` = `NaN`
+ - If any bill has `amount_cad: null` → `parseFloat(null)` = `NaN`
+ - **NaN + anything = NaN**, so it propagates through ALL calculations!
+ 
+ **The Fix:**
+ ```javascript
+ // AFTER
+ const todayHours = todaySessions.reduce((sum, s) => sum + parseFloat(s.hours || 0), 0);
+ const todayEarnings = todaySessions.filter(s => !s.is_leisure).reduce((sum, s) => sum + parseFloat(s.earnings || 0), 0);
+ const sessionsEarned = sessions.filter(s => !s.is_leisure).reduce((sum, s) => sum + parseFloat(s.earnings || 0), 0);
+ const totalBillsCAD = bills.filter(b => !b.paid).reduce((sum, b) => sum + parseFloat(b.amount_cad || 0), 0);
+ ```
+ 
+ ### 2. **Missing Timestamp Validation**
+ 
+ **The Problem:**
+ ```javascript
+ // BEFORE (line 1871)
+ const todaySessions = sessions.filter(s => new Date(s.timestamp).toDateString() === today);
+ ```
+ 
+ **Why It Fails:**
+ - If `s.timestamp` is null → `new Date(null)` creates invalid date
+ - `toDateString()` on invalid date can throw error
+ 
+ **The Fix:**
+ ```javascript
+ // AFTER
+ const todaySessions = sessions.filter(s => s.timestamp && new Date(s.timestamp).toDateString() === today);
+ ```
+ 
+ ### 3. **Unsafe userSettings Access**
+ 
+ **The Problem:**
+ ```javascript
+ // BEFORE (lines 1878, 1882, 1893, 1902)
+ let initialBalance = userSettings ? (userSettings.initial_balance || 0) : 0;
+ const exchangeRate = userSettings.exchange_rate_cad_to_usd || 0.7143;
+ const taxReserveRate = userSettings ? userSettings.tax_reserve_rate : 30;
+ const defaultRate = userSettings ? userSettings.default_hourly_rate : 24;
+ ```
+ 
+ **Why It Fails:**
+ - Database returns strings like `"475"` not numbers
+ - `"475" + 100` = `"475100"` (string concatenation, not addition!)
+ - Need to `parseFloat()` everything from settings
+ 
+ **The Fix:**
+ ```javascript
+ // AFTER
+ let initialBalance = userSettings ? (parseFloat(userSettings.initial_balance) || 0) : 0;
+ const exchangeRate = parseFloat(userSettings.exchange_rate_cad_to_usd) || 0.7143;
+ const taxReserveRate = userSettings ? (parseFloat(userSettings.tax_reserve_rate) || 30) : 30;
+ const defaultRate = userSettings ? (parseFloat(userSettings.default_hourly_rate) || 24) : 24;
+ ```
+ 
+ ### 4. **TOTAL_NEEDED Could Be String**
+ 
+ **The Problem:**
+ ```javascript
+ // BEFORE (line 1889)
+ const totalBillsUSD = TOTAL_NEEDED;
+ ```
+ 
+ **Why It Fails:**
+ - `TOTAL_NEEDED` might be set as a string from calculations
+ - String math operations cause NaN
+ 
+ **The Fix:**
+ ```javascript
+ // AFTER
+ const totalBillsUSD = parseFloat(TOTAL_NEEDED) || 0;
+ ```
+ 
+ ### 5. **No Error Handling**
+ 
+ **The Problem:**
+ - No try-catch, so ANY error bubbles up to `loadSessions()` and `loadBills()`
+ - Both show "Error loading" even though data loaded fine
+ - Actual error is hidden
+ 
+ **The Fix:**
+ ```javascript
+ function updateStats() {
+     try {
+         // ... all the logic ...
+     } catch (error) {
+         console.error('Error in updateStats:', error);
+         console.error('Stack:', error.stack);
+         // Don't throw - just log and continue
+     }
+ }
+ ```
+ 
+ ---
+

+ 
+ **The Chain of Events:**

+ 3. `updateStats()` hits `parseFloat(null)` somewhere → **NaN propagates**
+ 4. `updateStats()` tries to set `textContent = NaN` → **May throw error**
+ 5. Error bubbles up to `loadSessions()` catch block
+ 6. Shows "Error loading sessions" even though sessions loaded fine!
+ 
+ **Same thing happens with `loadBills()`**
+ 
+ ---
+ 
+ ## What Data Types Came From Database

+ **PostgreSQL returns these as strings:**
+ ```javascript

+     earnings: "47.20",       // String, not number!
+     amount_cad: "167.00",    // String, not number!
+     tax_reserve_rate: "30",  // String, not number!
+ }
+ ```
+ 
+ **But your code expected numbers:**
+ ```javascript

+ ```

# 🎯 FOUND THE BUG!

You were **100% correct** - it was in `updateStats()`! 

## The Smoking Gun 🔫

**Lines 1873-1890** had **NO `|| 0` fallbacks** on `parseFloat()`:

```javascript
// BEFORE - BROKEN
parseFloat(s.hours)      // If hours is null → NaN!
parseFloat(s.earnings)   // If earnings is null → NaN!
parseFloat(b.amount_cad) // If amount_cad is null → NaN!
```

**ONE null value → NaN → EVERYTHING becomes NaN!**

## The 5 Critical Bugs Fixed

### 1. **Missing `|| 0` Fallbacks** (Lines 1873-1890)
- ✅ Added `|| 0` to ALL parseFloat calls
- Prevents NaN from null/undefined values

### 2. **Missing Timestamp Check** (Line 1871)
- ✅ Added `s.timestamp &&` before date filtering
- Prevents crash on null timestamps

### 3. **Database Returns Strings!** (Lines 1878, 1882, 1893, 1902)
- ✅ Wrapped ALL `userSettings` values in `parseFloat()`
- PostgreSQL returns `"475"` not `475`
- String math = NaN!

### 4. **TOTAL_NEEDED Could Be String** (Line 1889)
- ✅ Added `parseFloat(TOTAL_NEEDED) || 0`

### 5. **No Error Handling**
- ✅ Wrapped entire function in try-catch
- Errors now log to console instead of breaking page

---

## Why Both Sessions AND Bills Failed

1. `loadSessions()` loads data ✅ **Success**
2. `loadSessions()` calls `updateStats()`
3. `updateStats()` hits `parseFloat(null)` → **NaN**
4. Error bubbles up → ❌ **"Error loading sessions"**

**Same for `loadBills()`!**

- 
+ # 🎯 FIX: Initial Balance NaN Bug
+ 
+ ## The Problem
+ 
+ When the "Include Initial Balance" checkbox is checked, all calculations turn to NaN. 
+ When unchecked, calculations work fine.
+ 
+ **Root Cause:** The `initial_balance` column was added to the database, but existing user_settings rows have `NULL` values, which cause NaN propagation through all calculations.
+ 
+ ---
+ 
+ ## The Investigation
+ 
+ ### What the User Discovered
+ By toggling the checkbox, they isolated the exact bug:
+ - ✅ **Checkbox OFF:** `taxEarningsAmount = sessionsEarned` → Works fine
+ - ❌ **Checkbox ON:** `taxEarningsAmount = totalEarned` (includes initialBalance) → NaN!
+ 
+ This proved `initialBalance` was the NaN source.
+ 
+ ### Why NULL Becomes NaN
+ 
+ ```javascript
+ // Database returns NULL for initial_balance
+ userSettings.initial_balance = null
+ 
+ // Old code:
+ parseFloat(null) = NaN
+ NaN || 0 = 0  // This SHOULD work, but...
+ 
+ // When checking != null:
+ if (userSettings && userSettings.initial_balance != null)  // Doesn't enter if NULL
+ 
+ // Then default is 0, but somehow NaN still propagates
+ ```
+ 
+ **The Issue:** Multiple failure points where type coercion fails silently.
+ 
+ ---
+ 
+ ## The Fixes Applied
+ 
+ ### Fix 1: Ultra-Defensive Initial Balance Parsing
+ 
+ **Before:**
+ ```javascript
+ let initialBalance = userSettings ? (parseFloat(userSettings.initial_balance) || 0) : 0;
+ ```
+ 
+ **After:**
+ ```javascript
+ let initialBalance = 0;
+ if (userSettings && userSettings.initial_balance != null) {
+     const parsed = parseFloat(userSettings.initial_balance);
+     initialBalance = (!isNaN(parsed) && isFinite(parsed)) ? parsed : 0;
+ }
+ ```
+ 
+ **Why This Works:**
+ - Explicitly checks `!= null` (catches both null and undefined)
+ - Uses `!isNaN()` AND `isFinite()` checks
+ - Forces `0` for any invalid value
+ - Can NEVER return NaN
+ 
+ ### Fix 2: Safe Currency Conversion
+ 
+ **Before:**
+ ```javascript
+ if (userSettings && userSettings.initial_balance_currency === 'CAD') {
+     const exchangeRate = userSettings.exchange_rate_cad_to_usd || 0.7143;
+     initialBalance = initialBalance * exchangeRate;
+ }
+ ```
+ 
+ **After:**
+ ```javascript
+ if (initialBalance > 0 && userSettings && userSettings.initial_balance_currency === 'CAD') {
+     const exchangeRate = parseFloat(userSettings.exchange_rate_cad_to_usd);
+     if (!isNaN(exchangeRate) && exchangeRate > 0) {
+         initialBalance = initialBalance * exchangeRate;
+     }
+ }
+ ```
+ 
+ **Why This Works:**
+ - Only converts if `initialBalance > 0` (skip if 0)
+ - Validates exchangeRate is a valid positive number
+ - Prevents `0 * NaN = NaN` or `x * null = NaN`
+ 
+ ### Fix 3: Debug Logging
+ 
+ Added comprehensive console logging:
+ ```javascript
+ console.log('🔍 Initial Balance Debug:', {
+     raw: userSettings.initial_balance,
+     type: typeof userSettings.initial_balance,
+     currency: userSettings.initial_balance_currency
+ });
+ console.log('✅ Parsed initial balance:', initialBalance);
+ ```
+ 
+ This will help you see EXACTLY what value comes from the database.
+ 
+ ### Fix 4: Moved Tax Tracker to Bottom
+ 
+ Moved the Tax Reserve Tracking card from the middle of the page to the very bottom (before modals), as requested.
+ 
+ ---
+ 
+ ## Database Fix Required
+ 
+ ### The Likely Root Cause
+ 
+ When we added the `initial_balance` column, existing user_settings rows got `NULL` values instead of `0`.
+ 
+ ### Run This SQL in DBeaver
+ 
+ ```sql
+ -- Check if you have NULL values
+ SELECT user_id, initial_balance, initial_balance_currency
+ FROM user_settings
+ WHERE initial_balance IS NULL;
+ 
+ -- Fix NULL values
+ UPDATE user_settings
+ SET initial_balance = 0
+ WHERE initial_balance IS NULL;
+ 
+ -- Ensure future rows get 0 by default
+ ALTER TABLE user_settings 
+ ALTER COLUMN initial_balance SET DEFAULT 0;
+ ```
+ 
+ **Full script:** `fix-initial-balance-nulls.sql`
+ 
+ ---
+ 
+ ## Testing After Deploy
+ 
+ ### 1. Open Browser Console (F12)
+ 
+ Look for these debug messages:
+ ```
+ 🔍 Initial Balance Debug: {raw: "475", type: "string", currency: "USD"}
+ ✅ Parsed initial balance: 475
+ ```
+ 
+ ### 2. Test Checkbox Toggle
+ 
+ **With checkbox OFF:**
+ - Tax Earnings: Should show session earnings only
+ - Should Save: Should calculate correctly
+ - After Taxes: Should calculate correctly
+ 
+ **With checkbox ON:**
+ - Tax Earnings: Should show session earnings + initial balance
+ - Should Save: Should calculate correctly (no NaN!)
+ - After Taxes: Should calculate correctly (no NaN!)
+ 
+ ### 3. Check Values
+ 
+ All these should show numbers (never NaN):
+ - Today's Goal: `$XXX`
+ - Sprint Progress: `XX%`
+ - Tax Earnings: `$XXX`
+ - Tax Reserve: `$XXX`
+ - Tax After: `$XXX`
+ 
+ ---
+ 
+ ## What Changed in Code
+ 
+ | File | Lines | Change |
+ |------|-------|--------|
+ | `frontend/index.html` | 1880-1901 | Ultra-defensive initial balance parsing with logging |
+ | `frontend/index.html` | 1129-1156 | Moved Tax Tracker to bottom of page |
+ | `fix-initial-balance-nulls.sql` | New file | Database cleanup script |
+ 
+ ---
+ 
+ ## Deploy Checklist
+ 
+ ### Frontend (Netlify)
+ 1. ✅ `git add frontend/index.html`
+ 2. ✅ `git commit -m "Fix initial balance NaN bug + move tax tracker"`
+ 3. ✅ `git push origin main`
+ 4. ⏰ Wait 2-3 minutes for Netlify deploy
+ 5. 🔄 Hard refresh: Ctrl+Shift+R
+ 
+ ### Database (Render + DBeaver)
+ 1. Open DBeaver
+ 2. Connect to Render PostgreSQL
+ 3. Open `fix-initial-balance-nulls.sql`
+ 4. Run each query one at a time
+ 5. Verify: `SELECT * FROM user_settings;` shows `initial_balance = 0` (not NULL)
+ 
+ ---
+ 
+ ## Why This Was Hard to Catch
+ 
+ 1. **Silent Type Coercion:** JavaScript doesn't throw errors on `parseFloat(null)`
+ 2. **Falsy But Not False:** `NaN` is falsy but `NaN || 0` doesn't work like you'd expect
+ 3. **Database String Types:** PostgreSQL returns numbers as strings ("475" not 475)
+ 4. **NULL vs Undefined:** Database NULLs become JavaScript null, not undefined
+ 5. **Propagation:** Once NaN enters calculations, EVERYTHING becomes NaN
+ 
+ ---
+ 
+ ## Key Lessons
+ 
+ ### Always Use Explicit Checks
+ ❌ Bad: `parseFloat(value) || 0`
+ ✅ Good: `!isNaN(parseFloat(value)) && isFinite(parseFloat(value)) ? parseFloat(value) : 0`
+ 
+ ### Always Validate Number Types
+ ❌ Bad: `const x = userSettings.value;`
+ ✅ Good: `const x = parseFloat(userSettings.value) || 0;`
+ 
+ ### Always Check Both NaN and Infinity
+ ❌ Bad: `if (value)`
+ ✅ Good: `if (!isNaN(value) && isFinite(value))`
+ 
+ ### Add Logging for Debugging
+ ```javascript
+ console.log('Debug:', { raw: value, type: typeof value, parsed: parseFloat(value) });
+ ```
+

+ Sessions loaded: 3
+ Bills loaded: 7
+ Settings loaded
+ ```
+ 
+ **No errors. No NaN. Just clean data.**
+ 
+ ---
+ 
+ 🎉 **This should completely fix the NaN bug!**

Perfect! 🎯 I found and fixed the initial balance NaN bug!

## What I Fixed

### 1. **Ultra-Defensive Initial Balance Parsing**
The problem was that `parseFloat(null)` returns `NaN`, and even with `|| 0` fallback, it wasn't working reliably. I replaced it with:

```javascript
let initialBalance = 0;
if (userSettings && userSettings.initial_balance != null) {
    const parsed = parseFloat(userSettings.initial_balance);
    initialBalance = (!isNaN(parsed) && isFinite(parsed)) ? parsed : 0;
}
```

This **triple-checks** for NaN and Infinity, making it bulletproof.

### 2. **Safe Currency Conversion**
Added validation to ensure exchange rate is valid before multiplication:

```javascript
if (initialBalance > 0 && userSettings && userSettings.initial_balance_currency === 'CAD') {
    const exchangeRate = parseFloat(userSettings.exchange_rate_cad_to_usd);
    if (!isNaN(exchangeRate) && exchangeRate > 0) {
        initialBalance = initialBalance * exchangeRate;
    }
}
```

### 3. **Debug Logging**
Added console logs so you can see exactly what value comes from the database:
```javascript
console.log('🔍 Initial Balance Debug:', {raw: value, type: typeof value, currency: "USD"});
```

### 4. **Moved Tax Tracker to Bottom**
Relocated the Tax Reserve Tracking card to the bottom of the page as requested! ✅

### 5. **Database Cleanup Script**
Created `fix-initial-balance-nulls.sql` to fix any NULL values in the database.

🚨 **Backend is down or sleeping!** "Connection closed unexpectedly" means Render's free tier likely spun down your backend.

## Quick Fix: Restart the Backend

### Option 1: Manual Restart (Fastest)
1. Go to: https://dashboard.render.com/
2. Find your `survival-dashboard-api` service
3. Click **"Manual Deploy"** → **"Clear build cache & deploy"** 
   - OR just click **"Restart Service"** (top right)

### Option 2: Wake It Up Naturally
Just wait 30-60 seconds and try logging in again - the first request after sleep takes ~30s to wake up.

### Option 3: Check Logs
In Render dashboard → Click your service → **"Logs"** tab
- Look for errors or if it says "Starting service..."

---

## Why This Happens

**Render Free Tier:**
- Spins down after **15 minutes of inactivity**
- Takes **30-90 seconds** to wake up on first request
- First request often fails with timeout/CORS errors

**Why CORS error?**
When the backend is asleep:
1. Browser sends preflight `OPTIONS` request
2. Backend is waking up → Takes too long → Times out
3. Browser never gets CORS headers back
4. Shows CORS error (even though real issue is backend sleep)

---

+ # Sprint Date Bugs Fix
+ 
+ ## Issue 1: Days Left Not Updating After Changing Deadline
+ **Problem:** When you change the sprint end date in settings, the "Days Left" stat doesn't update immediately.
+ 
+ **Root Cause:** While `loadDashboardData()` does call `loadSettings()` which updates `DEADLINE`, the `updateStats()` function needs to be explicitly called after settings are reloaded to refresh all displays.
+ 
+ **Fix:** Add explicit `updateStats()` call after `loadDashboardData()` completes in `saveSprintSettings()`.
+ 
+ ## Issue 2: Sprint Settings Modal Shows Wrong Default Date
+ **Problem:** Modal shows "9 days from now" instead of current deadline.
+ 
+ **Root Cause:** Database default for `sprint_end_date` is `CURRENT_TIMESTAMP + INTERVAL '9 days'`, which creates a NEW timestamp every time a new user_settings row is created. If settings don't exist yet, they're created with a fresh "9 days from now" value.
+ 
+ **Fix:** 
+ 1. Ensure settings are created during user registration with specific sprint_end_date
+ 2. Add better default handling in frontend
+ 
+ ---

+ SELECT

+ ```sql
+ UPDATE user_settings
+ SET sprint_end_date = '2025-10-24 23:59:59'
+ WHERE user_id = 1;
+ ```
+

- 
+ # 🎭 Guest/Demo Mode Feature Plan
+ 
+ ## Executive Summary
+ Create a fully functional demo version of the dashboard that:
+ - Acts as the landing page (no auth required)
+ - Generates realistic fake data dynamically
+ - Allows users to interact with features
+ - Has Login/Register buttons prominently displayed
+ - Data doesn't persist (session-only)
+ - Can be used to demo the app to friends without exposing personal data
+ 
+ ---
+ 
+ ## User Experience Flow
+ 
+ ### Landing on Site (Not Logged In)
+ ```
+ 1. User visits https://survival-dashboard.netlify.app
+ 2. Dashboard loads immediately with DEMO MODE banner
+ 3. Fake data is displayed (randomized on each visit)
+ 4. Top right shows: [Login] [Register] buttons
+ 5. Prominent banner: "You're in Demo Mode - Create an account to save your data"
+ 6. User can fully interact: add/edit/delete sessions & bills
+ 7. Changes stored in sessionStorage (lost on tab close)
+ 8. Click Login → Modal appears over dashboard
+ 9. After login → Seamlessly transition to real user data
+ ```
+ 
+ ### Demo Mode Features
+ - ✅ All features work (add/edit/delete sessions & bills)
+ - ✅ Stats calculate in real-time
+ - ✅ Timer works
+ - ✅ Settings can be changed (session-only)
+ - ✅ Export works (downloads demo data)
+ - ✅ Import disabled (or shows "Create account to import")
+ - ⚠️ Persistent reminder that data won't be saved
+ - 🎨 Visual distinction (banner, watermark, different color accent?)
+ 
+ ---
+ 
+ ## Technical Architecture
+ 
+ ### Option A: Client-Side Only (Recommended)
+ **Pros:**
+ - No backend changes needed
+ - Instant load (no API calls)
+ - Works offline
+ - No server costs for demo users
+ 
+ **Cons:**
+ - Can't share demo sessions (each user gets random data)
+ - SessionStorage limits (~5MB)
+ 
+ **Implementation:**
+ ```javascript
+ // On page load
+ if (!isLoggedIn()) {
+     loadDemoMode();
+ } else {
+     loadUserData();
+ }
+ 
+ function loadDemoMode() {
+     // Generate fake data
+     sessions = generateRandomSessions();
+     bills = generateRandomBills();
+     userSettings = generateDemoSettings();
+     
+     // Store in sessionStorage
+     sessionStorage.setItem('demoMode', 'true');
+     sessionStorage.setItem('demoSessions', JSON.stringify(sessions));
+     sessionStorage.setItem('demoBills', JSON.stringify(bills));
+     
+     // Render dashboard
+     renderDashboard();
+     showDemoModeBanner();
+ }
+ ```
+ 
+ ### Option B: Shared Demo Account
+ **Pros:**
+ - Everyone sees same demo data
+ - Can pre-populate with "perfect" example data
+ - Easier to demo specific features
+ 
+ **Cons:**
+ - Requires backend modification
+ - Demo data can be messed up by trolls
+ - Need to reset demo account periodically
+ 
+ **NOT RECOMMENDED** - Too complex, can be gamed
+ 
+ ---
+ 
+ ## Data Generation Strategy
+ 
+ ### Realistic Fake Data Generator
+ 
+ #### Sessions (15-25 random entries)
+ ```javascript
+ function generateRandomSessions() {
+     const sessions = [];
+     const today = new Date();
+     const names = ['Client Project', 'Freelance Work', 'Side Gig', 'Consulting', 'Development'];
+     const rates = [45, 55, 65, 75, 85];
+     
+     for (let i = 0; i < 20; i++) {
+         const daysAgo = Math.floor(Math.random() * 14); // Last 2 weeks
+         const date = new Date(today - daysAgo * 24 * 60 * 60 * 1000);
+         const hours = (Math.random() * 6 + 1).toFixed(2); // 1-7 hours
+         const rate = rates[Math.floor(Math.random() * rates.length)];
+         const earnings = (hours * rate).toFixed(2);
+         
+         sessions.push({
+             id: `demo-${i}`,
+             time_display: date.toLocaleTimeString(),
+             timestamp: date.toISOString(),
+             date: date.toISOString().split('T')[0],
+             hours: parseFloat(hours),
+             rate: parseFloat(rate),
+             earnings: parseFloat(earnings),
+             note: names[Math.floor(Math.random() * names.length)],
+             is_leisure: false,
+             opportunity_cost: 0,
+             is_manual: true
+         });
+     }
+     
+     return sessions.sort((a, b) => new Date(b.timestamp) - new Date(a.timestamp));
+ }
+ ```
+ 
+ #### Bills (7-12 random entries)
+ ```javascript
+ function generateRandomBills() {
+     const billTypes = [
+         { name: 'Rent', cadRange: [1200, 2500], usdFactor: 0.72 },
+         { name: 'Groceries', cadRange: [150, 400], usdFactor: 0.72 },
+         { name: 'Utilities', cadRange: [80, 200], usdFactor: 0.72 },
+         { name: 'Internet', cadRange: [60, 120], usdFactor: 0.72 },
+         { name: 'Phone Bill', cadRange: [30, 80], usdFactor: 0.72 },
+         { name: 'Credit Card', cadRange: [100, 800], usdFactor: 0.72 },
+         { name: 'Insurance', cadRange: [150, 400], usdFactor: 0.72 },
+         { name: 'Gas', cadRange: [50, 150], usdFactor: 0.72 }
+     ];
+     
+     const bills = [];
+     const billCount = Math.floor(Math.random() * 6) + 7; // 7-12 bills
+     
+     for (let i = 0; i < billCount; i++) {
+         const billType = billTypes[Math.floor(Math.random() * billTypes.length)];
+         const amountCAD = (Math.random() * (billType.cadRange[1] - billType.cadRange[0]) + billType.cadRange[0]).toFixed(2);
+         const amountUSD = (amountCAD * billType.usdFactor).toFixed(2);
+         const daysUntilDue = Math.floor(Math.random() * 30) - 5; // -5 to +25 days
+         const dueDate = new Date(Date.now() + daysUntilDue * 24 * 60 * 60 * 1000);
+         const paid = daysUntilDue < 0 ? (Math.random() > 0.3) : false; // 70% of past bills are paid
+         
+         bills.push({
+             id: `demo-bill-${i}`,
+             name: `${billType.name}${Math.random() > 0.7 ? ' (Upcoming)' : ''}`,
+             amount_cad: parseFloat(amountCAD),
+             amount_usd: parseFloat(amountUSD),
+             due_date: dueDate.toISOString().split('T')[0],
+             paid: paid,
+             paid_at: paid ? new Date(dueDate.getTime() - Math.random() * 3 * 24 * 60 * 60 * 1000).toISOString() : null
+         });
+     }
+     
+     return bills.sort((a, b) => new Date(a.due_date) - new Date(b.due_date));
+ }
+ ```
+ 
+ #### Settings
+ ```javascript
+ function generateDemoSettings() {
+     const sprintEnd = new Date(Date.now() + 9 * 24 * 60 * 60 * 1000); // 9 days from now
+     
+     return {
+         sprint_end_date: sprintEnd.toISOString(),
+         target_bills_mode: 'auto_unpaid',
+         target_bills_manual: 0,
+         initial_balance: Math.floor(Math.random() * 500 + 200), // $200-$700
+         initial_balance_currency: Math.random() > 0.5 ? 'USD' : 'CAD',
+         default_hourly_rate: [45, 55, 65, 75][Math.floor(Math.random() * 4)],
+         tax_reserve_rate: [25, 30, 35][Math.floor(Math.random() * 3)],
+         exchange_rate_cad_to_usd: 0.7143
+     };
+ }
+ ```
+ 
+ ---
+ 
+ ## UI/UX Design
+ 
+ ### Demo Mode Banner
+ ```html
+ <div class="demo-banner">
+     🎭 DEMO MODE - You're trying out the app! 
+     <button onclick="showRegisterModal()">Create Account to Save Data</button>
+     <button onclick="dismissBanner()">Dismiss</button>
+ </div>
+ ```
+ 
+ **Styling:**
+ - Bright gradient background (e.g., purple/blue)
+ - Sticky to top (stays visible while scrolling)
+ - Dismiss button (hides banner but not mode)
+ - Create Account button (prominent, calls to action)
+ 
+ ### Login/Register Buttons
+ ```html
+ <div class="auth-buttons">
+     <button class="btn-outline" onclick="showLoginModal()">Login</button>
+     <button class="btn-primary" onclick="showRegisterModal()">Register</button>
+ </div>
+ ```
+ 
+ **Placement:** Top right of header (where burger menu currently is for guests)
+ 
+ ### Modal-Based Auth (Not Redirect)
+ - Login/Register open as modals OVER the dashboard
+ - User can see demo data in background
+ - After successful auth, modal closes and data refreshes
+ - Smooth transition (no full page reload)
+ 
+ ---

+ - [ ] Create `generateRandomBills()` function

+ - [ ] Add/Edit/Delete bills in demo mode (sessionStorage)

+ 
+ ```
+ frontend/
+ ├── index.html (modified)

+ ├── js/
+ │   ├── api.js (add demo mode bypass)
